targetTexts.1: “I loathe my own life; I will express my complaint and speak in the bitterness of my soul.
targetTexts.2: I will say to God: Do not condemn me! Let me know why You prosecute me.
targetTexts.3: Does it please You to oppress me, to reject the work of Your hands and favor the schemes of the wicked?
targetTexts.4: Do You have eyes of flesh? Do You see as man sees?
targetTexts.5: Are Your days like those of a mortal, or Your years like those of a man,
targetTexts.6: that You should seek my iniquity and search out my sin—
targetTexts.7: though You know that I am not guilty, and there is no deliverance from Your hand?
targetTexts.8: Your hands shaped me and altogether formed me. Would You now turn and destroy me?
targetTexts.9: Please remember that You molded me like clay. Would You now return me to dust?
targetTexts.10: Did You not pour me out like milk, and curdle me like cheese?
targetTexts.11: You clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
targetTexts.12: You have granted me life and loving devotion, and Your care has preserved my spirit.
targetTexts.13: Yet You concealed these things in Your heart, and I know that this was in Your mind:
targetTexts.14: If I sinned, You would take note, and would not acquit me of my iniquity.
targetTexts.15: If I am guilty, woe to me! And even if I am righteous, I cannot lift my head. I am full of shame and aware of my affliction.
targetTexts.16: Should I hold my head high, You would hunt me like a lion, and again display Your power against me.
targetTexts.17: You produce new witnesses against me and multiply Your anger toward me. Hardships assault me in wave after wave.
targetTexts.18: Why then did You bring me from the womb? Oh, that I had died, and no eye had seen me!
targetTexts.19: If only I had never come to be, but had been carried from the womb to the grave.
targetTexts.20: Are my days not few? Withdraw from me, that I may have a little comfort,
targetTexts.21: before I go—never to return—to a land of darkness and gloom,
targetTexts.22: to a land of utter darkness, of deep shadow and disorder, where even the light is like darkness.”
